main_text.p: finales[?] ex his & Augustinianis, quàm ex aliorum Mendicantium sectis, ut in quadam ordinaria quaestione Ioannis Chelmestoni apud Nordouicum olim legi.

Et quamuis Euangelium illud diabolicum, de quo iam diximus, fuerit quorundam fratrum astutia, ac Romanum Pontificum arcano praecepto de letum: mansit tamen eadem in Deum blasphemia, ac summa à rectà fide in Christum, unicum huma-nigeneris seruatorem, defectio, ad nostra usque tempora, in Papistarum meritis de condigno & congruo, in sanctorum suffragijs, Papae largitionibus atq; indulgentijs, in bonis operibus, oblationibus, donis, votis, solutionibus, coenobiorum erectionibus, ieiunijs, vigilijs, somnijs, silentijs, horis, organis, sequentijs, hymnis, cantilenis, campanis, altaribus, simulachris, purgatorijs, missis, murmurationibus, mitris, delubris, templis, synagogis, sacrificijs, sectis, breuiarijs, bullis, lustralibus, aquis, ra-furis[?], unctionibus, coemeterijs, cineribus, palmis, calculis precarijs, candelis, calcibus, crucibus, cathedris, cappis, candelabris, cereis, thuribulis, popis, ritibus Babylonicis, Aegyptiacis cultibus spectaculis, reliquijs, regulis, monachis, mendicabulis, chordis, codicib. ocreis, bracchis, pseudodoctrinis, sententijs, summis, decretis, luminibus, picturis,

page.notes: Long s rendered as s throughout. Doubtful readings: "finales" (opening word, the first letter is ambiguous), "furis" (in the line "ra-furis", the word is unclear and may be a longer word split by the line end). Printed "ieiunijs" appears with a reading close to "leiunijs" and "vigilijs" as "uigilijs" (u/v normalised). The word "mendicabulis" is printed as such and kept. Page is a continuation: the opening fragment is marked cont="true".
